question: How much safely skipped verification does the actual range tree buy?
gate0: GTS already establishes pivot trees, table execution and cost models. This is diagnosis, not a new index claim.
keeper: PAR_STRONG/FULL/TILED; arity 10; leaf limit 20; update threshold 10
arithmetic: Dimension-ordered FP64 sub/mul/add, squared-radius inclusion, FP32 sqrt field; complete physical-instance IDs and fields
warmup: First 8 registered queries per mode, once before retained passes
timing: Host-query H2D through complete result D2H and per-query output release; 32-query pass sum; median of four observations, no CI or promotion
events: Non-observer four-phase CUDA events; observer per-level events are diagnostic only, never primary performance
replay: Actual leaf lists and exact candidate masks preloaded; NOT algorithms or end-to-end speedups. Preparation, copies and cache storage disclosed separately.
block_core: Existing verify_distances<1,false,true> AoSoA32 FULL verifier; grid covers ceil(N/256), real mask skips only noncandidates; no new distance kernel
setup: Rebuild actual frozen tree and refit original safe bounds, compare with prior audited dump. Layout conversion, cache generation/upload and teardown excluded from query sums and reported separately.
stop: Stop on GPU runtime, isolation or quality failure; preserve record. No automatic rerun of admitted samples or budget extension.
maintenance: Reuse existing two rebuild event records; stable occurrence and vector-lineage identities; supplement only missing second-rebuild tree state, not a workflow rerun
